sources.title: Machine Learning Algorithms for Detecting and Preventing Cyber Threats
sources.snippet: The paper reviews various ML algorithms including Graph Neural Networks, Adversarial Learning, Federated Learning, Explainable AI and Reinforcement Learning. Each algorithm plays a crucial role in helping to improve the detection and mitigation of cyber attacks. Graph Neural Networks help to model complex relationships in cybersecurity data.
